CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: feat(hw/i2c): real I2C primitives (i2c-open/i2c-read/i2c-write/i2c-close) over Linux i2c-dev(4) -- third real hardware bus (UART, SPI, I2C) shipped same day. 14 real assertions incl. a byte-perfect round-trip (make test-i2c). Real system /dev/i2c-0 deliberately not touched (root-owned SMBus). Apple #18629. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
